description: This source file defines the FixedSizeBuffer class, which manages a contiguous block of memory for buffering purposes within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It provides functionality to allocate segments within a fixed-size byte buffer and reset its state.

classes.name: FixedSizeBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages a fixed-size byte buffer, providing methods to allocate segments and reset the buffer state.

methods.name: FixedSizeBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a specified size in bytes.

methods.name: TryGetSegment
methods.description: Attempts to allocate a segment of the specified size from the buffer, returning true if successful.

methods.name: OnResetState
methods.description: Resets the buffer's used byte count to zero, effectively clearing its state.
